scenes.text:
CONCEPT: Minimalist Studio Desk Setup
SETTING: Bright creative studio corner, mid-morning.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Surface is a natural pale oak desk; background is an off-white limewashed wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack sits upright on the oak desk, turned at a three-quarter angle to display its front and side structure.
COMPOSITION: Product positioned on the right third with a wide calm margin; the left side is left empty for text.
CAMERA: Eye-level, medium close-up, 50mm lens.
LIGHTING: Soft directional daylight from a high window on the left, casting a subtle contact shadow beneath the base.
COLOUR PALETTE: Pale oak tan, warm off-white, and muted charcoal. The dark matte backpack separates sharply against the bright pale wall and table.
PROPS: A slim ceramic pen cup and a closed beige linen notebook placed to the far right, softly blurred.
MOOD AND STYLE: Professional, modern, and uncluttered still-life advertising.

CONCEPT: Boutique Hotel Bench
SETTING: Sunlit boutique hotel entryway, late morning.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Light travertine stone flooring; background is a fluted blonde maple wood wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack stands upright centered on a low, smooth ash wood bench, facing forward.
COMPOSITION: Placed slightly left of center; generous negative space on the right for typography.
CAMERA: Straight-on shot at bench height, 70mm lens with shallow depth of field.
LIGHTING: Diffused morning light from the right with gentle fill from the front; crisp separation from the warm wood backdrop.
COLOUR PALETTE: Cream travertine, honey blonde maple, and soft beige. The black exterior pops against the light neutral textures.
PROPS: A rolled linen coat placed neatly to the far left of the bench, slightly out of focus.
MOOD AND STYLE: Sophisticated travel luxury, warm and airy aesthetic.

CONCEPT: Executive Lounge Chair
SETTING: Designer transit lounge, early afternoon.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Surface is a warm caramel-tan leather lounge chair; background is a soft beige micro-cement wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack rests upright in the seat of the chair, angled slightly forward.
COMPOSITION: Centered horizontally, leaving the upper half of the frame clean for editorial copy.
CAMERA: Low angle looking slightly upward at the chair, 85mm lens.
LIGHTING: Balanced architectural ceiling spot creating a clear highlight on the bag's curves and a grounded contact shadow on the leather.
COLOUR PALETTE: Warm caramel, light sand, and brass accents. Deep silhouette creates immediate focal contrast against the light-toned leather.
PROPS: none
MOOD AND STYLE: Premium executive commute, structured and refined.

CONCEPT: Architect Drafting Table
SETTING: High-ceilinged architectural studio, midday.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Smooth white matte laminate drafting table; background is a soft grey polished concrete wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack stands upright on the corner of the drafting table, angled toward the viewer.
COMPOSITION: Positioned on the left third with ample calm margin around its outline; right side reserved for text.
CAMERA: Table-height shot, three-quarter perspective, 50mm lens.
LIGHTING: Neutral studio softbox lighting from above left, rendering clean contours and matte texture separation.
COLOUR PALETTE: Light concrete grey, pure white, and brushed silver. High-contrast monochromatic isolation makes the backpack the immediate hero.
PROPS: A frosted acrylic triangular scale ruler laid flat on the far right, blurred.
MOOD AND STYLE: Industrial precision, modern minimalist lifestyle.

CONCEPT: Contemporary Cafe Corner
SETTING: Quiet urban espresso bar, mid-afternoon.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Matte light-grey terrazzo tabletop; background is a pale sage-green painted brick wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack sits upright on a sturdy bentwood chair tucked partly beside the table, front facing forward.
COMPOSITION: Off-center to the right, framing clean negative space across the sage-green wall on the left.
CAMERA: Straight-on, medium shot at chest height, 45mm lens.
LIGHTING: Golden ambient side light with a soft reflector fill, accentuating surface textures.
COLOUR PALETTE: Pale sage green, neutral white terrazzo, and light beechwood. The dark exterior establishes clear contrast against the pastel backdrop.
PROPS: A small white ceramic coffee cup in the distant mid-ground, heavily blurred.
MOOD AND STYLE: Casual metropolitan lifestyle, warm and approachable.

CONCEPT: Modern Gallery Plinth
SETTING: Contemporary art gallery nook, morning.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Sandstone-textured floor; background is a flat muted terracotta partition wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack is displayed upright on a low, geometric matte-sand display plinth.
COMPOSITION: Centered in the lower frame with substantial calm wall space above for text insertion.
CAMERA: Direct eye-level, wide-normal 65mm lens, crisp edge-to-edge focus.
LIGHTING: Clean overhead gallery spotlights creating defined, soft-edged drop shadows on the plinth.
COLOUR PALETTE: Warm terracotta, pale sand, and limestone. Matte black construction stands out boldly against the earthen, desaturated backdrop.
PROPS: none
MOOD AND STYLE: Sculptural, editorial, and design-led presentation.

CONCEPT: Airy Co-Working Library
SETTING: Scandinavian-inspired shared library, afternoon.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Pale birch wood study table; background is an out-of-focus row of muted linen book spines.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack stands upright on the wide birch bench alongside the table, angled to reveal its depth.
COMPOSITION: Product grounded on the left; calm, diffuse background on the right ready for branding.
CAMERA: Slightly elevated angle, 50mm focal length.
LIGHTING: Broad diffused window light illuminating the front face smoothly, keeping shadows transparent.
COLOUR PALETTE: Pale birch yellow, oatmeal linen, and soft white. Clear silhouette separation against light organic tones.
PROPS: A closed slate-grey hardbound sketchbook placed in the distant right background.
MOOD AND STYLE: Intellectual, productive, and calm Nordic simplicity.

CONCEPT: Modern Apartment Console
SETTING: Bright residential entrance hallway, late afternoon.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Surface is a light grey marble console table; background is a soft eggshell plaster wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: A backpack stands firmly upright on the marble surface, facing direct front.
COMPOSITION: Positioned on the right side of the frame; clear open field across the left.
CAMERA: Level horizontal perspective, 50mm prime lens.
LIGHTING: Gentle wrap-around window light providing crisp rim highlights along the upper contour.
COLOUR PALETTE: Cool marble grey, eggshell white, and brushed chrome. Sharp tonal break between the dark subject and pale architectural elements.
PROPS: A small matte ceramic catchall tray in the far background, out of focus.
MOOD AND STYLE: Premium everyday luxury, clean and functional elegance.
